description: Each GPU cloud's and marketplace's posted on-demand prices per GPU, as its page on the site shows them (lowest and highest that day, as posted, with the configuration of the lowest) and its average in the index, standardized to the GPU's benchmark contract so providers compare like for like. Give a provider (e.g. "CoreWeave", "RunPod") and/or a GPU. For questions like "what does RunPod charge for an H100?" or "Lambda GPU pricing".

provider.description: A provider's name or page id; omit for all providers.

name: get_provider_prices

high_price.description: Highest posted price that day, USD per GPU-hour, as posted

index_average.description: This provider's average in the index, standardized to the benchmark contract

low_price.description: Lowest posted price that day, USD per GPU-hour, as posted

read_at.description: When its prices were last read

title: GPU prices by provider
